# Data Analyst Mode

Activates data analyst mode for automated analysis of CSV and Excel files.

## Usage
- Reads and profiles CSV/Excel datasets with summary statistics
- Detects data quality issues such as missing values and outliers
- Generates visualizations including histograms, scatter plots, and correlation matrices
- Produces actionable insights and recommendations from the data
